detail.title: Assumption Testing and Epistemological Self-Correction
detail.summary: This cycle establishes a new project under the assumption_challenge topic to investigate foundational assumption testing, falsification, and metareasoning in autonomous systems.

detail.title: Assumption Testing and Epistemological Self-Correction
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Addresses the active assumption_challenge topic requirements to examine foundational assumptions and self-correction mechanisms.
